documents.title: Clarification sought from Advance Agrolife Ltd
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Advance Agrolife Limited reported its highest ever quarterly performance for Q1 FY27, with revenue reaching 3304 million rupees and a net profit of 225.5 million rupees. Management highlighted ongoing backward integration, capacity expansions such as the 4x scale-up in 2,4-D herbicides and upcoming facilities at Gidani and Dahej, and an export target of 20% by FY29. The company also pointed to strategic advantages from its inland geography and anti-dumping duties on Pretilachlor. Advance Agrolife Limited reported its financial and operational results for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026, highlighting growth in revenue, EBITDA, and PAT. Management emphasized ongoing backward integration initiatives, capacity expansions including a 4x scale-up in 2,4-D and upcoming operations at Unit-4, and strategic export growth targets.

guidance.claim: The company aims to increase its export revenue share from approximately 2% to 20% by FY29.
guidance.quote: We are aggressively targeting an increase in our export revenue share from a negligible 2% today to 20% by FY29.

demand_outlook.claim: Pretilachlor is the premier post-emergence herbicide for paddy in India.
demand_outlook.quote: Core Application: Pretilachlor is the premier post-emergence herbicide for Paddy (Rice), India’s largest crop by acreage.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that maintaining a strategic balance between Kharif and Rabi products flattens revenue volatility and ensures consistent cash flow visibility.
demand_outlook.quote: By maintaining a strategic balance between Kharif (Monsoon) and Rabi (Winter) products, the Company effectively flattens the revenue volatility curve typical of the agrochemical sector, ensuring consistent cash flow visibility throughout the fiscal year.

demand_outlook.claim: Q3 FY26 income increased by 18% year-on-year due to higher demand and the addition of new customers.
demand_outlook.quote: • AAL’s Q3 FY26 Income at ₹ 1338 million increased by 18% Y-o-Y on the back of increased demand and addition of new customers.

capex_expansion.claim: The company aims to commence operations at its new Unit-4 technical manufacturing facility at Gidhani by Q2 FY27 with an estimated first-phase capex of approximately ¥ 250 million.
capex_expansion.quote: AAL aims to commence operations at our new Unit-4 technical manufacturing facility at Gidhani by Q2 FY27, with an estimated first-phase capital expenditure of approximately ¥ 250 million.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is setting up a 3.75 MW solar power plant, which is presently under implementation with regulatory approvals under process.
capex_expansion.quote: AAL is in the process of setting up a 3.75 MW solar power plant with the objective of increasing the use of renewable energy and reducing its carbon footprint. The project is presently under implementation, and necessary regulatory approvals are under process.

capex_expansion.claim: The company entered into an MOU to acquire land for setting up Unit-5 at Dahej II GIDC Industrial Estate for manufacturing technical grade pesticides.
capex_expansion.quote: Company has entered into an MOU for acquisition of land admeasuring 17,491.02 sq. mtrs. for setting up a new plant, proposed to be named Unit-5, situated at Dahej II GIDC Industrial Estate, Bharuch, Gujrat for manufacturing of technical grade pesticides.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is in the process of setting up a 3.75 MW solar power plant.
capex_expansion.quote: AAL is in the process of setting up a 3.75 MW solar power plant to increase the use of renewable energy and reduce its carbon footprint.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is considering setting up manufacturing facilities for Pretilachlor and PEDA with installed capacities of about 13 tonnes per day and 10 tonnes per day respectively.
capex_expansion.quote: • The company is considering setting up of manufacturing facilities for Pretilachlor and PEDA, with installed production capacities of about 13 tonnes per day and 10 tonnes per day respectively.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q1 was steady at 10.6%accompagnied by a sharp rise in profit after tax.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin for Q1 were steady at 10.6%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company possesses an extensive library of over 410 CIB and RC registrations.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company's extensive library of 410+ CIB & RC registrations acts as a robust shock absorber.

orders_capacity.claim: Top 10 customers contribute approximately 69% of revenue.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to commence operations at its new Unit-4 technical manufacturing facility at Gidhani by Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: AAL aims to commence operations at our new Unit-4 technical manufacturing facility at Gidhani by Q2 FY27, with an estimated first-phase capital expenditure of approximately ¥ 250 million.

management_commitments.claim: The company is aggressively targeting an increase in its export revenue share to 20% by FY29.
management_commitments.quote: We are aggressively targeting an increase in our export revenue share from a negligible 2% today to 20% by FY29.
